rules: Guide L656-657,890-893: disabling marks history cleanup for next enable and prevents history retention. Disabled tag success alone cannot prove retained inputs or recovery; no explicit guarantee of disabled tagging persistence was found.
Guide L883-893: resetHistory skips only current interpolation while retaining current-frame inputs. Avoid treating expected scene-history reset as a permanent provider failure.
Guide L1016-1022,1106-1108: submit tagging command lists and finish input/PresentId calls before matching Present.

Guide L1112-1137: positive return codes are warnings, negative codes errors. Warning RESOURCE_SIZES_MISMATCH=6 explicitly skips interpolation; warning does not prove a coherent frame or require a permanent fault.

Header L300-308 and guide L1032-1053: last status has framesPresented, frameGenResult and isFrameGenEnabled. framesPresented includes rendered frames; every Present including DXGI_PRESENT_TEST updates status. API success alone is not generated-frame proof.
Guide L860: Hudless texture format must match backbuffer. No process-global immutable format requirement was found; input transitions still need current-frame consistency.
Guide L1058-1084: resize/destroy require tagging-work completion and no concurrent context use. Recovery must retain R5 lifetime protections.

Header L463-483: initial maxInterpolatedFrames bounds later selection; frequent SetNumInterpolatedFrames may compile/reallocate. Retain initialized 6x capability; required heap sizes are not measured resident allocation.

limits: No reviewed upstream change proves or fully fixes the user-specific Dogtown reproduction. New local fixes must be tested and clearly separated from hypotheses.

R5 LOCAL usage exceeds its budget while native Present delays grow; process-wide counters do not identify engine, driver or provider ownership. No proven automatic eviction or RAM-spill fix is adopted.
Preserve shaders, upscaler binary/profile, ratio 1.5, color/HDR/exposure behavior, default 3x and maximum 6x unlock; exclude DLSS5 and extra mod stacking.
Final production diff, artifact hashes and test status are recorded separately; this review does not assert unrun gameplay tests.

memory_contracts.finding: Microsoft documents possible stuttering and performance penalties when application CurrentUsage exceeds Budget. This supports a pressure hypothesis, not ownership or a proven leak.
Over-budget residency can intermittently freeze the process. Moving frequently used resources to system memory can severely reduce FPS; no simple API identifies safely spillable engine resources.
Release frees the object at zero; returned reference count is intended only for testing. R7 does not redesign the inherited pin/probe reference-count hook or perform post-final-release object access.

Command-list Reset is legal while the previous execution is still pending (unlike command allocator Reset), provided the allocator and list rules are met. A newer recording can appear before a post-Execute CPU observer runs.
Native ExecuteCommandLists return is a CPU submission boundary, not GPU completion. ResTrack observes only after forwarding the original call.

Queue Signal updates its fence after previous queue work completes. A separate per-queue fence timeline can measure progress without CPU waiting. Completion does not establish present/display timing or prove memory is safely evictable.

local_source_corrections.name: FFX context routing registry synchronization
evidence: OptiScaler/upscalers/FeatureProvider_Dx12.cpp:143 moves the old feature into DelayedDestroy.
OptiScaler/Util.h:61-63 destroys it on a detached worker after two seconds.
OptiScaler/proxies/FfxApi_Proxy.h previously read/inserted/erased the same ankerl map without synchronization. Foreground create/configure and other delayed destroy workers can overlap.
local_source_corrections.implementation: FfxContextRegistry retains the existing map type; short locks serialize Set/Find/atomic Take. External provider calls stay outside locks. Original dispatch/fallback and quality settings are unchanged.
local_source_corrections.validation: tests/r6_ffx_registry compiles the production helper and exercises 16000 concurrent context lifetimes, single-winner removal and fallback semantics. Final aggregate results are in TEST_RESULTS.json.
local_source_corrections.limit: Concrete source data race corrected; R5 log does not establish that this race occurred at Dogtown or caused its memory growth.

local_source_corrections.name: R7 generation-aware post-submission retirement
evidence: BeforeCommandSubmission identifies recording generation before native Execute. Concurrent Reset/re-record can publish the same command-list pointer at a newer generation before AfterCommandSubmission.
The old identity-only retirement could erase that new pending recording; Microsoft explicitly permits command-list Reset while prior execution is pending.
local_source_corrections.implementation: Capture a generation watermark under the pending mutex at entry; post-submit retirement removes only matching identities no newer than this watermark. Keep submission admission across native call and both observers. No new TLS ticket registry or queue references in ResTrack.
local_source_corrections.validation: Actual production callback and core pending-generation regressions are in tests/r7_tracking and tests/r7_progress; final results are TEST_RESULTS.json.
local_source_corrections.limit: This corrects a source lifetime-tracking race; no log demonstrates it caused Dogtown VRAM growth.

local_source_corrections.name: R7 tracked Release audit and sampled CPU timing
evidence: Reverse-index lock spans temporary AddRef plus nonfinal original Release probe; descriptor cleanup and final original Release run outside it.

Removing the temporary pin or cleaning raw pointer keys after final destruction can introduce stale-pointer/address-reuse hazards. Descriptor binding metadata does not provide a complete resource-generation contract.
local_source_corrections.implementation: Preserve existing COM call order/refcounts/mutex coverage. Sample one in 64 calls for mutex acquisition, AddRef/native probe and final native Release durations. No claims that native COM Release is GPU completion.
local_source_corrections.validation: tests/r7_tracking extracts the real callback and checks reference balance, lock coverage, weak-descriptor cleanup, shutdown bypass, lifetime dispatch and exact sample counts.
local_source_corrections.limit: This is diagnosis, not an established contention fix. Sampled maxima are lower bounds; inherited probe assumptions and unobserved calls remain outside proof.

local_source_corrections.name: R7 nonblocking queue progress observations
local_source_corrections.implementation: After native submission, observe only XeFG-already-tracked queues. Use a separate progress fence, bounded try-lock, at most one outstanding marker and no blocking waits. Retain original teardown completion proofs; observations never authorize resource destruction.
local_source_corrections.limit: Separates sampled queue progress from CPU submission and SDK status. An incomplete sample cannot alone identify paging, GPU load or a leak; actual GPU overhead remains unmeasured.

No force Evict/MakeResident cycle, priority manipulation, synthetic byte purge, RAM offload or automatic quality/multiplier reduction was adopted.
